Many players are stuck at Sandy Pots due to low mob density. You're limited to a few maps, and progression is locked behind the 20 Arcane mob kills. The problem is most players can only spawn around 9 Arcane mobs. So here's how to work around it.

__**Recommended Setup (what helped me progress)**__  
(The more is better, but less is still bearable)
- Tenteyecle Nostalgia around level 27 (54% chance)  
- Arcane Charging + Backup Energy = Arcane mobs spawn every 192 kills
Try grinding in Glublin to upgrade Arcane Charging (mine is at level 2)

**Max:**  
• Shaman: 3rd and 4th
• Bubo: 4th and 5th
• Arcane Cultist: 3rd, 4th, and 15th

__**Setup and Strategy**__  
1. Place your **crystal near the rope**   
2. Toggle auto on, stand near the rope and let it **spam basic attacks**  
3. Keep **skulls flying** on both platforms at all times  
4. **Jiggle the rope** (move up and down by clicking the rope) to spread skulls more efficiently

__**TL;DR**__  
If you just leave Auto on, you won’t progress.  
You need to **juggle between platforms** by clicking the rope.

If one platform has no skulls flying, click the rope and stay there until mobs respawn.  
Once skulls are out, **immediately switch** to the other platform and repeat.
